findings.title: copy() strips null members from untouched target data and from arrays
findings.why: `copy` copies objects with `merge({}, value)`, and `merge` deletes every null member. So `applyMergePatch({a:{b:null}}, {c:1})` returns `{a:{},c:1}`, although the spec says members the patch does not name SHALL be kept. The same happens inside arrays. A patch of `{a:[{x:null}]}` gives `{a:[{}]}`, but arrays are supposed to replace the target value wholesale. `copy` needs a plain deep clone that keeps nulls. Only recursive merging of patch objects should strip them.
